bio.text: Christine Hunschofsky represents District 95 in the Florida House of Representatives. According to the House, Hunschofsky was elected in 2020 and reelected subsequently, and served as Minority Leader pro tempore for 2024-2026.
Hunschofsky served on the Parkland city commission from 2013 to 2016 and as mayor of Parkland from 2016 to 2020.
The House lists Hunschofsky's residence as Parkland and an education of a business administration degree from Boston University (1992) and an MBA from Babson College (1996).
